entries.title: Zechariah 3:1
segments: And he showed me Joshua the high priest standing before the angel of Jehovah, and Satan standing at his right hand to be his adversary.

entries.title: Zechariah 3:2
segments: And Jehovah said unto Satan, Jehovah rebuke thee, O Satan; yea, Jehovah that hath chosen Jerusalem rebuke thee: is not this a brand plucked out of the fire?

entries.title: Zechariah 3:3
segments: Now Joshua was clothed with filthy garments, and was standing before the angel.

entries.title: Zechariah 3:4
segments: And he answered and spake unto those that stood before him, saying, Take the filthy garments from off him. And unto him he said, Behold, I have caused thine iniquity to pass from thee, and I will clothe thee with rich apparel.

entries.title: Zechariah 3:5
segments: And I said, Let them set a clean mitre upon his head. So they set a clean mitre upon his head, and clothed him with garments; and the angel of Jehovah was standing by.

entries.title: Zechariah 3:6
segments: And the angel of Jehovah protested unto Joshua, saying,

entries.title: Zechariah 3:7
segments: Thus saith Jehovah of hosts: If thou wilt walk in my ways, and if thou wilt keep my charge, then thou also shalt judge my house, and shalt also keep my courts, and I will give thee a place of access among these that stand by.

entries.title: Zechariah 3:8
segments: Hear now, O Joshua the high priest, thou and thy fellows that sit before thee; for they are men that are a sign: for, behold, I will bring forth my servant the Branch.

entries.title: Zechariah 3:9
segments: For, behold, the stone that I have set before Joshua; upon one stone are seven eyes: behold, I will engrave the graving thereof, saith Jehovah of hosts, and I will remove the iniquity of that land in one day.

entries.title: Zechariah 3:10
segments: In that day, saith Jehovah of hosts, shall ye invite every man his neighbor under the vine and under the fig-tree.
